Substitute \(A=\frac{m}{100}W\), \(B=\frac{m(m-5)}{10000}W\), \(C=\left(1-\frac{m}{100}\right)W\) into \(A-B=C\):

\[
\frac{m}{100}W-\frac{m(m-5)}{10000}W=\left(1-\frac{m}{100}\right)W
\]

Divide by \(W\):

\[
\frac{m}{100}-\frac{m(m-5)}{10000}=1-\frac{m}{100}
\]

\[
m^2-205m+10000=0
\]

\[
m=\frac{205\pm 45}{2}=125,80
\]

Since \(m\) is a percentage water content, \(m\le 100\), so \(m=80\).

\[
\boxed{80}
\]
